name: @podium/commands
description: L1 command CONTRACTS (ADR 3 D1): name, versioned schemas, resource/action policy, default-closed transport exposure, delivery/offline class, redaction, and the ADR 3 Amendment 1 ownership/attribution/error-consistency columns. Contracts only — handlers live with their L3 features and join at the composition root. Imports @podium/model and @podium/protocol; no services, no IO, no database.
